business_scope.primary_industry_name: Consumer Polling and Cross-Border Market Research Platform

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (with constitutional judicial review and hybrid administrative-law framework)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Colombia–United States Trade Promotion Agreement (2006, in force 2012) — investment and digital services chapter
Colombia–European Union FTA (2013) — trade in services, investment and dispute resolution
Colombia–Canada FTA (2011) — includes an investment chapter
Colombia–Chile FTA (2009) — investment and services liberalization
Colombia–Mexico FTA (1994) — investment, services and digital trade provisions
Colombia–Spain Double Taxation Avoidance Agreement (2008) — relevant to foreign software-royalty and services income

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 526 de 1999 (creating UIAF), Ley 1121 de 2006 (AML amendments), Ley 1762 de 2015 (money laundering and terrorist financing framework), Ley 2195 de 2022 (transparency and the Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales – RUB), Decreto 830 de 2021 (UBO identification and registration rules), Decreto 1670 de 2016 (SARLAFT regulatory measures for certain sectors), Circular Básica Jurídica 029 de 2014 (Superintendencia de Sociedades AML/CFT guidance), and Circular Básica Legal 030 de 2023 (financial-sector AML/CFT instructions).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Spanish-language S.A.S. incorporation charter (private deed or public deed, signed by all shareholders)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille for foreign signatures on the incorporation deed; notarization in the country of origin and translation into Spanish if executed abroad

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation of each corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Official commercial registry authority of the shareholder's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille by the competent authority of the shareholder's country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney for incorporation formalities and RUT registration
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille and sworn/certified Spanish translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Valid passport or government-issued identification of each UBO, legal representative and incorporator
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized copy plus apostille and Spanish translation if not in Spanish

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified translation and legalization certificate for foreign public documents (if the country of origin is not a party to the Hague Apostille Convention)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the country of origin and Colombian consulate

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory enhanced due diligence for PEPs and UBOs under SARLAFT standards; screening against UN Security Council sanctions, OFAC SDN List, EU and UK sanctions, Interpol Red Notices, and Colombian domestic lists (Fiscalía General de la Nación and Consejo de Seguridad Nacional); all shareholders, UBOs at or above 25% ownership, board members, legal representatives, and authorized signatories must be risk-profiled; ongoing transaction monitoring and suspicious-transaction reporting to UIAF is required once banking or payment rails are activated.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES) — online name application processed through the local Cámara de Comercio (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá) and supervised by Superintendencia de Sociedades
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The proposed corporate name must be expressed in Spanish/Latin-script characters; no separate transliteration registration is required for a foreign word, but the name must be distinct and not phonetically or visually identical to an existing registered trademark or company name; all corporate names must contain the suffix 'S.A.S.' and avoid misleading terms about regulated activities.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant may file a recurso de reposición (reconsideration request) with the same Cámara de Comercio within 10 business days; if the Name Clearance is still denied, a recurso de apelación may be raised with Superintendencia de Sociedades within 5 business days; a separate fresh name reservation may be filed at any point, and an administrative homologation request may be made if the desired name incorporates a protected trademark; no extension beyond the 30-day reservation window is permitted without a new reservation.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual offices are not unconditionally accepted for a Colombian S.A.S.; the statutory registered office (domicilio) must be a real, accessible address for service of legal and administrative notices. A shared physical address or 'virtual office' may be permissible for a low-risk market-research SaaS only if it is a genuine fixed space in Colombia where judicial notifications can be received. A fully non-physical or mailing-only address will likely be rejected by the Cámara de Comercio and may trigger substance review.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low for a standard low-risk market-research entity, quantified at approximately 5-10% annual probability; unannounced inspections become more likely if a virtual office, shared postal address, or inconsistent commercial-substance indicators are identified by DIAN, Superintendencia de Sociedades or UIAF.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name reservation and online commercial registration (matrícula mercantil) at Cámara de Comercio
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Cámara de Comercio (local chamber, e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff set by Cámara de Comercio

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarial fees for notarization of S.A.S. incorporation documents (private deed or public deed)
Commercial Registry filing of the statutory charter and shareholder/UBO identification forms
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory registration tariff based on authorized capital and assets

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: RUT/NIT tax registration and digital signature certificate
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales) and authorized certificate provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Nominal government fee for electronic signature credential

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified English-to-Spanish translation and apostille processing of foreign corporate and identity documents (set of approximately three documents)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Certified translation agency and apostille office

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Professional legal and accounting fee for S.A.S. incorporation package, by-law drafting, AML KYC file assembly, and UBO filing
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Fixed professional-service fee prevailing for cross-border S.A.S. incorporations

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales (RUB) filing via DIAN
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: No government fee; included in professional legal fee if delegated

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law 1258 of 2008 (Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada), Articles 5, 17, 18 and 19; Código de Comercio of Colombia (Decree 410 of 1971), Articles 110, 111, 118-120 and 142; Decree 1074 of 2015 (Single Regulatory Decree of Commerce, Industry and Tourism); DIAN Resolution 55 of 2019 regarding RUT registration.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social (e.g. Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá), Commercial Registry Section; overall corporate supervision exercised by Superintendencia de Sociedades.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución y Estatutos (single private incorporation document and bylaws), to be recorded in the Cámara de Comercio.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum statutory capital exists for an S.A.S. The capital is freely fixed. However, the subscribed shares must be paid in at least one-third (1/3) of their nominal value upon subscription. Contributions in cash are deposited in a Colombian financial institution and may be used after inscription. No escrow account is legally required.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION OF CONSUMER PANEL SURVEY PLATFORM S.A.S. — KNOW ALL MEN BY THESE PRESENTS: That, on [Date], the undersigned shareholders, as sole founders, acting pursuant to Law 1258 of 2008 and the Company Bylaws, resolved unanimously: (1) the Company is incorporated upon registration in the Cámara de Comercio; (2) the subscribed capital is accepted, each outstanding share being paid in accordance with bylaws; (3) the registered office is established at Calle 100 #15-89, Bogotá, Colombia; (4) [Name] is appointed Chief Executive Officer and legal representative, and [Name] as Secretary General; (5) the officers are authorized to execute filings and appearances before DIAN and Cámara de Comercio. This resolution shall be recorded in the corporate minute book.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Name Availability and Homologation Search
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá – Commercial Name Registry / RUES (Registro Único Empresarial) online portal.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Access the 'Ventanilla Virtual' of the Cámara de Comercio or RUES; complete the corporate name search form inserting the proposed name 'Consumer Panel Survey Platform S.A.S.' and the ISIC code 7320. Submit the application and await the official name homologation certificate. This step certifies that no identical or confusingly similar company name is already registered. All shareholder identification data must be entered exactly as applicable.
required_dossiers: Scan of identity document (cédula) or passport for each shareholder
Proposed corporate name form
Sector classification activity code (ISIC 7320)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is rejected for similarity, re-file a new application with a distinctive alternate name or adding a brand-based prefix; the chamber issues a new homologation certificate within 2 business days without additional substantive requirements.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Notarization of Private Incorporation Document
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public (Notaría) and all founding shareholders; Colombian attorney to prepare the document.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: An authorized corporate attorney drafts the 'Documento Privado de Constitución y Estatutos' containing the clauses required by Law 1258 of 2008: corporate name, domicile, duration, corporate purpose, capital, classes of shares, management structure, general meeting rules, and arbitration clause. Each shareholder must sign with fingerprint and in person before a notary where the company's domicile is located. The notary records authentication of signatures only; notarized content is not mandatory unless real estate is contributed.
required_dossiers: Draft private incorporation document and bylaws
Identity documents of all shareholders
Power of attorney if one shareholder acts on behalf of another
Foreign shareholder registration number (NIT or assigned certificate) when applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary observes omissions in required clauses, amend the draft by supplement (anexo), re-execute signatures before the notary, and proceed to registry submission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration in the Commercial Registry of the Cámara de Comercio
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio with jurisdiction over the registered office (e.g. Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the originally executed private incorporation document together with Formulario de Registro Único Empresarial (RUES), the name homologation certificate, and proof of payment of the registration fee (derechos de inscripción) and mercantile registration fee (matrícula mercantil). The submission may be made physically at the Chamber office or electronically via the virtual window in PDF format; original signatures must be convalidated upon request. After examination, the Chamber registers the company, issues the temporary certificate, and assigns the registration number.
required_dossiers: Originally executed private incorporation document with bylaws
Homologation name certificate
Formulario RUES (single business registry form)
Proof of payment of registration fees
Identity documents of officers and shareholders
Non-resident shareholder documentary proof if subject to AML/KYC review
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Chamber issues 'requerimiento' (clarification query), the founding attorney files an amendment within 10 business days through the same registry window; if the defect is substantive, the document is corrected and re-presented with a new payment receipt.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration with DIAN and Obtaining NIT
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DIAN - Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales, Registro Tributario (MUISCA system).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After commercial registration, access the DIAN MUISCA portal and complete the RUT (Registro Único Tributario) application using the registration number from the Cámara de Comercio. Define the fiscal obligations: income tax (renta), VAT (IVA) where applicable, national withholding, and municipal industry and commerce tax (ICA). The system assigns the NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria). The RUT is signed electronically or through an appointment at DIAN for physical signature.
required_dossiers: Certificate of existence and legal representation issued by the Cámara de Comercio
Private incorporation document and bylaws
Shareholder and officer identification documents
Proof of registered office address (utility bill or lease contract)
Pre-RUT file generated by the Cámara de Comercio
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DIAN flags an inconsistency, file a written 'respuesta a requerimiento' via the MUISCA portal or at the Customer Service branch, accompany with corrected documents, and request an updated RUT within 15 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration of Officers and Opening of Corporate Books
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio comertial registry – Registro de Nombramientos y Libros
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the minutes of the shareholders' meeting appointing the legal representative and other officers (CEO, secretary, or board members if any) to the Cámara de Comercio together with the form 'Registro de Dignatarios' and signed acceptance letters. Physically present the corporate minute book and shareholders register for initial stamping so that books are legally admissible. This step finalizes the corporate governance architecture.
required_dossiers: Minutes of the first shareholders' meeting approving the board resolution
Signed acceptance forms from appointed legal representative and officers
Form of appointment (Registro de Directivos)
Corporate minute book and shareholder register
NIT certificate and Chamber payment proof
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Chamber returns the books or form due to missing quorum proof, supplement the submission with the shareholder registry excerpt and re-instate the application within 10 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal Operation Clearances and Physical Premises Compliance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Municipal Government / Alcaldía, Secretaría de Planeación; Cuerpo de Bomberos for fire-safety clearance.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: If the company leases physical office premises, file with the local planning authority for a 'Certificado de Uso del Suelo' (zoning permit) verifying that market research and digital services activities are permitted, and obtain a 'Certificado de Funcionamiento' if required by local autocadastro. For any workplace with employees, submit a building occupancy declaration and coordinate a fire inspection with the Cuerpo de Bomberos. As the activity is SaaS / survey platform, no additional municipal industrial operating permit is necessary.
required_dossiers: Lease agreement or proof of legal occupancy
NIT and commercial registration certificate
Application for zoning compatibility certificate
Building blueprints or physical layout description
Occupational safety initial documentation if employees are hired
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the zoning officer denies compatibility, request a revision using the service-company classification; if rejection persists, relocate to an office in a mixed-use area and re-file. For fire risk, execute corrective infrastructure works and request a re-inspection within 10 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: ANLA - Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales or regional Corporación Autónoma Regional (CAR) depending on local jurisdiction.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Because the consumer-panel survey platform operates as an ISIC 7320 digital service and does not engage in physical manufacturing, there is no mandatory environmental impact assessment. The company shall prepare and preserve an internal 'Declaración de No Requerimiento de Licencia Ambiental' documenting the service activity, office area, absence of process wastewater, and use of municipal utilities. Should the company operate a back-up diesel generator, register the generator with the CAR and comply with emission thresholds under Decree 1076 of 2015.
required_dossiers: Activity certificate from Cámara de Comercio showing ISIC 7320
Environmental self-assessment form
Office lease and utility records
Generator technical sheet if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the regional CAR or ANLA unexpectedly classifies the activity as medium environmental impact, submit a comprehensive 'Plan de Manejo Ambiental' or, in rare cases, begin the full EIA process. This is an exceptional remedy as the ISIC 7320 scope is expressly treated as low-risk service operation.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable – ISIC 7320 consumer polling and market research SaaS does not trigger an industrial licensing requirement. General commercial regulation is administered by the Cámara de Comercio and the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (SIC) for consumer protection and competition matters.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No specific operating license or manufacturing permit required. For physical office use, only the municipal certificate of zoning compliance, the Mercantile Registry Certificate, and the fire-safety inspection result constitute the operational licenses.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA) for national-scale projects; regional Corporación Autónoma Regional (CAR) for local projects.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt – Low-risk service-sector activity under Law 99 of 1993 and Decree 1076 of 2015; no EIA, no preliminary environmental diagnosis, and no Environmental Management Plan mandatory for the pure SaaS and survey platform operations.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable to platform-only operations; for any small physical office, domestic wastewater discharge must meet Resolution 0631 of 2015 (BOD5 ≤ 50 mg/L, TSS ≤ 50 mg/L) and stormwater must not bypass municipal drains. If a diesel generator is installed, comply with Decree 1076 of 2015 emission thresholds (CO ≤ 500 ppm, NOx ≤ 500 ppm for emergency engines).

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire-safety clearance from Cuerpo de Bomberos (NFPA-adapted local inspection), structural load verification for office floors per NSR-10 (minimum live load 500 kg/m² for office use), and occupational health and safety registration with an ARL (e.g., ARL Sura) covering mandatory 5-day post-incident risk coverage. These clearances are triggered when a physical office is occupied.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) — Colombia's national tax and customs administration. Main portal: www.dian.gov.co. Operational portal: MUISCA (Modelo Único de Ingresos, Servicio y Control Automatizado) at muisca.dian.gov.co, used for RUT registration, NIT issuance, electronic invoice validation, export-of-services registration (RES), and periodic VAT/CIT filings.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a Colombian S.A.S.: (1) Execute a private incorporation document ('documento privado de constitución') before a notary or via Chamber of Commerce digital channels; non-resident shareholders appoint a local legal representative. (2) Register the company with the Cámara de Comercio; obtain the certificate of incorporation and 'pre-RUT' (preliminary RUT). (3) Finalize the RUT (Registro Único Tributario) electronically in MUISCA within 10 business days of incorporation; DIAN then assigns the definitive NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria). (4) Obtain a digital signature ('firma electrónica') from a DIAN-authorized certification provider to enable e-invoicing and RUT updates. (5) Update the RUT to reflect status as 'Responsable del IVA' (VAT taxpayer), ICA obligations with the respective municipality, and, if applicable, the 'Registro de Exportación de Servicios' (RES). (6) Maintain a registered local address ('domicilio principal') and notify DIAN of any changes within the statutory term. Foreign shareholders are permitted without special licensing, but the local legal representative must hold a valid Colombian residence or visa status for RUT authentication.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation — the S.A.S. is a separate capital company and a Colombian tax resident by incorporation, taxed at the 35% corporate income tax rate (tax year 2025) on worldwide income, including foreign-source SaaS and market-research revenue. No pass-through or US-style check-the-box election is available. Territorial_Scope: residents are taxed on global income; non-resident shareholders are taxed only through Colombian-source withholding (e.g., dividends, capital gains). Tax_Exempt_Zone is not a default; a reduced 20% CIT applies only upon an explicit Zona Franca grant.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Colombia lacks a check-the-box regime; classification is statutory. Available elections: (i) opt-in to 'Régimen Simple de Tributación' (SIMPLE) — a consolidated presumptive tax for entities with gross revenue ≤ 100,000 UVT (≈ COP 4,979.9 million for 2025), integrating income tax, VAT, ICA and other contributions; (ii) application for 'Zona Franca' status (20% CIT for 25 years) for eligible technology/export operations; (iii) voluntary early registration as a VAT responsible even before the first taxable transaction; (iv) waiver of VAT refunds in favor of crediting against future tax liabilities; and (v) selection of annual versus bimonthly VAT filing cycles based on volume. Hybrid-mismatch rules (thin capitalization and CFC 'transparencia fiscal internacional') apply automatically with no elective opt-out.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: IVA (Impuesto sobre las Ventas) — Colombia's value-added tax governed by Articles 420–481 of the Tax Statute (E.T.) and Decree 1625 of 2016 (DUR), administered by DIAN.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: None for S.A.S. legal entities — the company becomes a VAT 'responsable' from the first taxable sale, import, or service; RUT registration is mandatory before commencement of operations (Art. 437 E.T.). The 3,500 UVT threshold (COP 174,296,500 for tax year 2025, with UVT 2025 = COP 49,799) applies exclusively to qualifying natural persons claiming the 'no responsable' exception, not to corporations. Late registration triggers penalties under Arts. 641 and 653 E.T.; for a foreign platform selling digital services to Colombian consumers, nexus is established separately by the digital-services regime (Art. 420 literal c) E.T.) requiring local VAT registration irrespective of turnover.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory 'factura electrónica de venta' (FEV) with real-time pre-validation ('validación previa') through DIAN's MUISCA web services, governed principally by Resolution 000165 of 2023 and Resolution 000012 of 2021. Each FEV requires: a certified digital signature, a unique CUNE (Código Único de Numeración de Factura Electrónica) generated by DIAN's algorithm, an XML payload transmitted via API in near real-time, DIAN's acceptance/rejection response, and a human-readable PDF/format bearing a QR code. Colombia does not use physical fiscal stamps; clearance is entirely electronic. Contingency 'validación posterior' is permitted only for certified technical outages. Exporters must also issue electronic 'nota crédito/nota débito', transmit the 'documento soporte' for purchases from non-VAT-responsible parties, and file annual 'información exógena' reporting of export transactions.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating (0% VAT with refund rights) for export of services is available under Art. 481 literal e) E.T. and Art. 1.1.1.1. of Decree 1625/2016, as interpreted by DIAN Concept No. 0232 of 2023. Criteria: (i) the direct beneficiary is a non-resident entity without Colombian tax domicile; (ii) the service is used or exploited exclusively abroad ('utilización y aprovechamiento exclusivo en el exterior') — for the consumer-panel market-research SaaS, the data, surveys, and research deliverables must be hosted, processed, and delivered abroad for the foreign client's benefit; (iii) payment is received in foreign currency through an authorized FX intermediary or a registered 'cuenta de compensación' maintained with Banco de la República; (iv) the exporter holds an active DIAN 'Registro de Exportación de Servicios' (RES) in MUISCA; and (v) the export proceeds are repatriated within the legal FX term. B2B digital/research services meeting these tests qualify for 0% with input-VAT refund. Caution: platform revenue derived from advertisements or services 'used' by Colombian-resident panelists may be treated as taxable domestic services and must be ring-fenced to avoid partial disqualification.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Declaración de Exportación — DEX/SISCION Export) for physical goods; for the digital SaaS/consumer-panel service, the functional equivalent is the DIAN-approved 'Registro de Exportación de Servicios' (RES) entry in MUISCA and the FEV marked 0%.

Bill of Lading / Airway Bill / Electronic Delivery Certificate — transport document for physical media; for digital services, the signed international service contract plus platform delivery/log access evidence identifying the foreign client and the foreign use/benefit.

Inward Remittance Certificate — 'Declaración de Cambio por Servicios' (Form No. 1) or 'Comprobante de Ingreso al Mercado Cambiario' issued by an authorized FX intermediary, evidencing foreign-currency repatriation within the 180-day regulatory term; or a certificate of remittance to a registered 'cuenta de compensación'.
Commercial Invoice (Spanish/English) cross-referenced to the FEV (CUNE + QR), together with the DIAN 'documento soporte' for export-related local purchases where input VAT is claimed.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN cross-matches the RES, FEV e-invoices, FX remittance forms, and 'información exógena' declarations through specialized export-audit models, and PayPal/Wise payment rails not operating through authorized intermediaries will be flagged. Consequences of false or non-substantiated zero-rating: (i) 'sanción por inexactitud' (Art. 648 E.T.) of up to 200% of the additional tax determined, plus default interest ('intereses moratorios', approximately 1.5% monthly); (ii) 'sanción por devolución o compensación improcedente' (Art. 670 E.T.) of 20% of the refund improperly received, plus indexation; (iii) retrospective clawback of all input VAT credits linked to the disqualified export invoices; (iv) cancellation of the RES/RUT export status and up to 5 years' exclusion from export-refund procedures, with public disclosure on DIAN's infringement register; (v) criminal tax evasion ('evasión fiscal' — Art. 434A Criminal Code) with imprisonment from 48 to 108 months and fines where the evaded VAT exceeds the statutory threshold; and (vi) personal liability of the S.A.S. legal representative and shareholders for forged FX documents or false certificates under 'falsedad en documento privado' (Art. 289 Criminal Code).

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República de Colombia (Board of Directors) is the central bank and foreign-exchange authority, with the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia as the banking and FX-intermediary supervisor; the foreign-exchange regime is codified primarily in Resolution 8 of 2000 of the Banco de la República, Circular Reglamentaria Externa DCIN-83, and implementing rules issued under Decreto 1735 of 2020 and related decrees.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Colombia maintains a free-market managed floating exchange rate for the Colombian peso (COP) with full current-account convertibility for trade, services, and ordinary capital transactions. Capital-account transactions, including foreign direct investment (FDI), portfolio investment, and external credits, are generally unrestricted but must be routed through authorized intermediaries of the Colombian foreign-exchange market and registered with the central bank in the Registro Internacional de Inversiones; the inward FDI registration (Formulario No. 4) must be completed through the local bank before or upon receipt of funds. Profit and dividend remittances to non-resident shareholders are permitted without central-bank exchange approval once the foreign investment is registered and the company has complied with local corporate and tax prerequisites; the main legal hurdle is not FX convertibility but documentary compliance, including the dividend-withholding regime applicable to non-residents (currently generally 10 percent plus any applicable surcharge combined with the corporate income-tax rate on distributable profits) and proof that the capital injection was previously registered.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Export proceeds, including receipts from the export of market-research services, are subject to a mandatory channeling obligation ('canalización por el mercado cambiario') under Banco de la República rules: the full 100 percent of the export value must be brought through an authorized intermediary, either by conversion into COP, deposit into a registered local foreign-currency account, or deposit into an authorized compensation account (cuenta de compensación), within six months from the date of export declaration for goods or, for services, within six months of service performance or the corresponding contractual maturity date of the invoice. There is no mandatory fixed quota requiring conversion into pesos; the exporter may retain the foreign currency in approved accounts, but the applicable declaración de cambio (Formulario No. 1 for goods, Formulario No. 3 for service receipts and intangibles) must be submitted to the central bank through the commercial bank, and extensions are available only in justified circumstances. Failure to channel export proceeds is an exchange infraction exposing the company to supervisory sanctions, so the platform should systematize the reconciliation of every PayPal/Wise payout batch into the local bank treasury account within the regulatory term.

Operational Account (Cuenta Corriente) with foreign-currency account support

Operational Account (Cuenta Corriente) with Grupo Aval correspondent network

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility: Conditional High as a disbursement rail only, not as a treasury substitute. Wise, PayPal Mass Payout, and analogous electronic-money institutions are not authorized to operate as full deposit-taking banks in Colombia; they must operate through a licensed local payment-entity arrangement (SEDPE) or through correspondent arrangements with a Colombian Tier-1 bank, and all US-dollar flows related to the platform must ultimately be channeled through the regulated local banking system to satisfy the channeling obligation. Legal constraints include the prohibition on cross-border EMIs maintaining corporate treasury balances in COP without Colombian banking or deposit authorization, the requirement that the local entity keep its principal operating account with an authorized intermediary, and the need to document each financial-flow leg (platform respondent payout, aggregation, and settlement) to avoid characterization as an unauthorized money-transmission or electronic-money business under the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia regulatory perimeter.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: In practice, Colombian Tier-1 banks require the legal representative of the S.A.S. to appear physically at a local branch for the initial SARLAFT customer-knowledge interview, unless the bank has enabled fully non-face-to-face onboarding under Decreto 1413 de 2021 and Circular 004 de 2022; most banks still require at least one physical visit by the representative or by a locally appointed authorized signatory holding a notarized and apostilled power of attorney. Non-resident directors cannot open the corporate account without a Colombian-resident representative or legitimated board authorization; the bank will request an updated Cámara de Comercio certificate, the RUT, bylaws and capital contribution act, UBO declarations, and, in the case of cross-border shareholders, proof of source of funds.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore shareholders located in listed low-tax jurisdictions or OFC jurisdictions appearing in the S.A.S. shareholder register
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Apostilled certificate of incorporation and corporate registry extract for each shareholder; DIAN-issued tax-residence certificate; credible financial statements and bank reference letter proving source of wealth; UBO declaration and sworn source-of-funds statement; corporate organizational chart; and a memorandum explaining the business rationale for the corporate structure.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border digital receipts classified as unidentifiable e-commerce flows from consumer surveys without a named beneficiary
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed master service agreements and per-campaign client contracts; the ISIC 7320 platform terms and privacy policy; data-protection registration with the SIC and GDPR-equivalent compliance; structured export invoices and revenue schedules; transaction-level payout logs via PayPal Mass Payout and Wise; and a documented reconciliation memorandum showing the channeling of each batch to the Colombian bank within the statutory term.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident legal representative or shareholder-manager without Colombian residence and economic nexus, flagged as a high-ABAC or politically-exposed-person concern
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Apostilled power of attorney in favor of a Colombian-resident authorized signatory; appointment minutes of the board; police or criminal-record certificate from the home jurisdiction; professional background and CV; lease or services contract for the registered office; and a formal SARLAFT questionnaire completed with full UBO identification.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Payments routed through third-country aggregation platforms (Wise/PayPal) creating a perceived gap in the regulated FX channeling chain
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Banking compliance manual and flow diagram showing that EMIs are only front-end disbursement rails; corporate treasury policy requiring periodic consolidation of all funds into the local authorized-intermediary account; exact trace of transaction codes and declaración de cambio filings; opinion of the statutory auditor (revisor fiscal) confirming no unregistered FX operations; and subscription of the fintech entity to local AML and privacy frameworks applicable to payment aggregators.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The non-resident shareholder's capital contribution must be sent by SWIFT wire transfer (MT103) to the S.A.S.'s Colombian operating account held at an authorized intermediary, with the message containing the beneficiary S.A.S. legal name and NIT, the reference 'FOREIGN DIRECT INVESTMENT', and the FDI registration number previously obtained or simultaneously filed through the bank's Formulario No. 4 electronic registration; the funds should never be sent directly to a PayPal or Wise wallet because such routing would not satisfy the declaración de cambio and FDI-registration requirement. The bank will validate the consignment against the Cámara de Comercio certificate, evidence of the capital call, and the board minutes allocating the capital contribution, and will issue the corresponding channeling certificate for later capital repatriation and dividend remittances.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound settlements should be executed through: (a) SWIFT MT103/MT202 payments for supplier invoices, cloud infrastructure, royalties, and marketing services, each accompanied by the relevant tax-withholding certificates and the service-payment declaration (Formulario No. 3) or import-of-goods declaration (Formulario No. 2) filed through the bank's FX platform; (b) commercial documentary letters of credit governed by UCP 600 for material procurements when suppliers require bank-payment security; and (c) domestic peso-clearing rails (CUD direct-clearance, ACH, and the CENIT electronic clearing house) for local Colombian disbursements to survey participants and vendors. The platform must maintain a consolidated treasury calendar to cover the bank's FX trading cut-off times and avoid late channeling declarations; payments to related parties or tax-haven jurisdictions must be supported by transfer-pricing documentation because the Colombian tax administration applies OECD-aligned transfer-pricing rules to cross-border intercompany services.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: COP/USD deliverable currency forwards (forwards de tasa de cambio) traded over-the-counter with local banks, permissible only when backed by an underlying commercial receivable or payable of the S.A.S.

Cross-currency swaps (permutas de divisas) for medium-term hedging of USD-denominated capital or operating liabilities, subject to the same underlying-exposure requirement under Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia regulations.
FX options (opciones sobre divisas) used for asymmetric risk protection on the USD/COP exposure of the survey platform's cross-border invoicing, requiring evidence of the hedged transaction.

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) with offshore counterparties entered into through the local treasury or through an international bank's Colombian branch, permissible for risk management but subject to bank confirmation and underlying-operation documentation, since the COP is a deliverable currency and NDF structures must not be used to circumvent channeling rules.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil (Annual Commercial Registry Renewal)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before March 31 of each year for entities registered as of December 31
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal triggers recargo (surcharge) up to 40% of the applicable fee plus fines up to 17 UVT; failure to renew for three consecutive years results in administrative cancellation of the commercial registration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Financial Statements Approval and Commercial Registry Deposit (Estados Financieros + Acta de Asamblea)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Shareholders must approve annual financial statements no later than March 31; deposit with the Registry no later than April 30 (within one month after approval).
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late deposit exposes the entity to monetary fines imposed by the Superintendencia de Sociedades; continued failure may lead to renewal restrictions and reputational sanctions.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Declaración de Renta y Complementario (Annual Corporate Income Tax Return)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual filing window set by DIAN Resolution based on NIT numeric digit, generally between the last working day of August and the last working day of September of the taxable year immediately following the fiscal year; exact date varies by NIT last digit.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing triggers late-filing fine of 1% on gross tax due per month or fraction, minimum of 10 and maximum of 240 UVT per month; unpaid tax accrues monthly interest (15% annual rate currently).

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Información Exógena Annual (Annual Third-Party and Tax Information Return)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due date per DIAN Resolution, traditionally between April and June of each year for completed fiscal year, determined by NIT last digit.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-filing or late filing produces penalties under Article 651 of the Colombian Tax Code: 1% of the information value or up to 1,200 UVT per requirement, with additional fines if correct or omitted data are not corrected.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales (RUBF) Annual Update
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual update must be submitted electronically during the calendar period designated by DIAN Resolution (generally between May and July of each year, based on NIT last digit).
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to submit or update UBO information is subject to fine up to 1,200 UVT per piece of information omitted; continued non-compliance may trigger additional tax audits and blocking of tax clearance certificates.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Shareholders' Assembly Compliance (Asamblea Anual de Accionistas)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Internal corporate governance; minutes recorded in statutory Minute Book
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Must meet by March 31 of each year to examine annual accounts and appoint directors/statutory auditor where applicable.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-compliance may invalidate dividend distributions and approvals; Directors may be personally liable for losses derived from failure to call the meeting.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A Revisor Fiscal (statutory auditor) is mandatory for a S.A.S. if assets exceed 5,000 SMMLV; gross income exceeds 3,000 SMMLV; or the company has more than 30 shareholders (optional for simple S.A.S.). Alternatively, an independent certified audit (not necessarily Revisor Fiscal) is required by tax authorities when thresholds under Article 660 of the Tax Code are triggered; otherwise audit is voluntary.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: NIIF (IFRS as issued by IASB); S.A.S. classified under Grupo 2 applies NIIF para PYMES (IFRS for SMEs), except where mandatorily aligned with full IFRS.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The S.A.S. must disclose ultimate beneficial owners (each natural person owning or controlling directly/indirectly 5% or more of shares, voting rights, or financial ownership) in the RUBF portal annually. Any transfer of 5% or more of shareholding during the year must be reported in the annual update; DIAN cross-checks UBO data against share registry and commercial filings.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Registro de Actas (Minute Book for Shareholders and Directors)
Libro de Registro de Revisor Fiscal (Statutory Auditor Book, if applicable)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: 150 - 350 per year for virtual office/registered agent at a public notary or chamber-approved address
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: 1,500 - 4,000 per year for a low-risk market research S.A.S. (if audit thresholds are met)
